cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Grandad's embarrassed about the gazebo. Let's tell everyone the party moved indoors because the garden's unavailable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's already told Aunt Jean he set it on fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we all say, 'Everyone's fine; we're celebrating indoors.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Jean wants him to explain it in his birthday speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's his opening sentence too. Then straight to thanking her for the trifle.
